name: Spotlights
desc: Stage follow-spots throwing volumetric light cones that sweep across the frame on the beat, from soft hazy club beams to hard brutalist shafts, dappled gobos, RGB-split prisms and abstract scan-rays.

style.doc: beam=soft volumetric cone / gobo=dappled slat texture / hardedge=brutalist flat shaft + floor pool / scan=abstract fanning scan-rays (no mass) / prism=RGB-split iridescent

act.doc: sweep=smooth swing / chase=sequenced left-right / strobe=beat-gated flashes
